args.message: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

args.head: fix/banker-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `src/money.py` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP` while `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. This changes the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")`.

CI: passed (ci-0001)

2. **Fixed it** on a new branch `fix/banker-rounding`: changed the import and `quantize` call to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
3. **Ran CI** on the branch — passed (run `ci-0001`).
